bullets.text: AI-Powered Dating Conversations - Hinge's new 'Convo Starters' feature helps users initiate engaging chats.
Festive iPad Art Display - Apple showcases winning iPad designs on Battersea Power Station this Christmas.
Modular Headphone Upgrades - Fairphone's new headphones allow users to upgrade older models with improved sound.
Apple Watch Discounts - Major price drops on the latest Apple Watch Series 11 ahead of the holidays.
Waymo's Robotaxi Surge - Investor letter reveals Waymo is providing 250,000 robotaxi rides weekly.
AI Shopping Integration - OpenAI and Instacart enable grocery shopping directly within ChatGPT.
Claude Code in Slack - Anthropic's coding assistant now automates tasks directly within Slack.
Data Center Construction Halt - Environmental groups urge a moratorium on new data center approvals.
Adobe's YouTube Shorts Hub - New content creation space in Premiere mobile tailored for YouTube creators.
